table.retrieve:
SELECT
	dbo.purledger.suppinvcode ,
	dbo.purledger.suppinvdate,
	dbo.purledger.printbalance,
	dbo.purledger.grn,
	dbo.purledger.purinvcode ,
	dbo.purledger.purcatcode ,
	dbo.purledger.purtypecode,
	aliasname=(select accounts.aliasname from accounts where accounts.acccode=dbo.purledger.suppcode),   
	dbo.purledger.suppcode ,
	dbo.purledger.custcode ,
	dbo.purledger.salesmancode ,
	dbo.purledger.date ,
	NTN=SPACE(100),
	dbo.purledger.pocode ,
	dbo.purledger.discperc ,
	dbo.purledger.flatdisc ,
	dbo.purledger.misccharges ,
	misccharges1=dbo.purledger.misccharges1,   
	misccharges2=dbo.purledger.misccharges2,   
	misccharges3=dbo.purledger.misccharges3,   
	misccharges4=dbo.purledger.misccharges4,   
	misccharges5=dbo.purledger.misccharges5,   
	dbo.purledger.salestax ,
	dbo.purledger.posted ,
	dbo.purledger.postdate ,
	dbo.purledger.remarks ,
	dbo.purledger.invtotal,
	dbo.users.username,
	purledger.originaldate,
	purledger.modifiedby,
	purledger.postedby ,
	purledger.porb	,
	purledger.headerno,
	gcode=0,
	purledger.purinvpagesize,
	purledger.invgstperc1,
	dbo.purledger.headerinvno,
	dbo.purledger.AccountFor,
	dbo.purledger.PaymentMode,
	dbo.purledger.PaymentAccCode,
	dbo.purledger.Amt,
	dbo.purledger.AmtBy,
	dbo.purledger.AmtDate,
	dbo.purledger.AmtReference,
	dbo.purledger.Outstandingamt,
	dbo.purledger.marked,
	dbo.purledger.CurrencyCode,
	dbo.purledger.ConversionFactor,
	dbo.purledger.AssociatedSaleOrderCode,
	dbo.purledger.AssociatedSaleInvCode,
	dbo.purledger.UpdateAvgPriceWithNetRate,
	dbo.purledger.newpurchaseorderno,
	dbo.purledger.ImpactInventory,
	dbo.purledger.advancetax,
	dbo.purledger.AdvanceTaxAmt,
	dbo.purledger.icatcode,
	dbo.purledger.monthlycounter,
	dbo.purledger.dailycounter,
	dbo.purledger.creditdays,
	dbo.purledger.taxcategorycode,
	dbo.purledger.sitecode,
	dbo.purledger.targetsitecode
FROM 
	dbo.purledger,
	dbo.users     
WHERE
	( dbo.purledger.ImpactInventory= 'Y' ) And
	( dbo.purledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) and 
	( ( dbo.purledger.purinvcode = :r_InvCode ) )
